# Shokz UK

> Shokz UK specializes in innovative open-ear and bone conduction headphones designed for active lifestyles, sports, and professional use.

Shokz offers a comprehensive range of wireless audio products including bone conduction running headphones, waterproof swimming earbuds, open-ear earbuds, and professional headsets. The brand combines advanced audio technology with comfort and safety features for athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Bone conduction headphones
- Open-ear design
- Waterproof audio
- Sports headphones
- Wireless connectivity
- OpenRun series
- OpenSwim series
- OpenFit series
- IP68 waterproof rating
- Bluetooth technology
- Professional headsets
- Lightweight comfort
- DirectPitch technology
- Situational awareness
- USB-C charging

## Running & Sports Headphones

- [OpenRun Pro 2 Bone Conduction Headphone](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openrun-pro2): Premium bone conduction running headphones with waterproof design
- [OpenRun Wireless Sport Headphone](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openrun): Lightweight bone conduction running headphones with quick charge
- [OpenMove Affordable Bone Conduction Headphone](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openmove): Budget-friendly bone conduction headphones with open-ear design

## Swimming & Waterproof Headphones

- [OpenSwim Pro Waterproof Headphones](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openswim-pro): Bluetooth waterproof swimming headphones with IP68 rating
- [OpenSwim Waterproof Swimming Headphone](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openswim): IP68-rated waterproof swimming headphones with MP3 storage

## Open-Ear Earbuds

- [OpenFit Pro Open Earbuds](https://uk.shokz.com/pages/openfit-pro): Premium open-ear earbuds with OpenSound and noise reduction
- [OpenFit 2+ Open Ear Headphones](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openfit2-series): Open-ear headphones with Dolby Audio and 48-hour battery life
- [OpenFit Open Ear Headphone](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openfit): Wireless open-ear earbuds with comfort and situational awareness
- [OpenFit Air Open-Ear Headphone](https://uk.shokz.com/products/openfit-air): Lightweight open-ear headphones with DirectPitch technology
- [OPENDOTS ONE](https://uk.shokz.com/products/opendots-one): Clip-on open earbuds with lightweight comfort and secure fit
